targets.rawSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS candidates FROM analytics.learning_candidate_fact GROUP BY status ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'proposed' THEN 1 WHEN 'evaluating' THEN 2 WHEN 'promoted' THEN 3 WHEN 'rejected' THEN 4 WHEN 'rolled_back' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END
SELECT date_trunc('day', updated_at) AS time, status AS metric, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS value FROM analytics.learning_candidate_fact WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', updated_at) AS time, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS "rollbacks" FROM analytics.learning_candidate_fact WHERE status = 'rolled_back' AND $__timeFilter(updated_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT skill_name, uses, resolution_rate, avg_token_cost, avg_turn_count FROM skill_resolution_rates ORDER BY uses DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT date_trunc('day', started_at) AS time, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(array_length(skills_activated, 1), 0)), 0)::BIGINT AS "activated (offered)", COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(array_length(skills_used, 1), 0)), 0)::BIGINT AS "used (engaged)" FROM analytics.task_segment_fact WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH activated AS (SELECT unnest(skills_activated) AS skill_name, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS offered FROM analytics.task_segment_fact WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND array_length(skills_activated, 1) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1), used AS (SELECT unnest(skills_used) AS skill_name, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS engaged FROM analytics.task_segment_fact WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND array_length(skills_used, 1) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT a.skill_name, a.offered, COALESCE(u.engaged, 0) AS engaged, ROUND(COALESCE(u.engaged, 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(a.offered, 0), 3) AS engagement_rate FROM activated a LEFT JOIN used u ON u.skill_name = a.skill_name ORDER BY engagement_rate ASC NULLS FIRST, a.offered DESC LIMIT 25
